data.subject: CANCEL my membership - fifth attempt
data.body: I requested to cancel my wine club membership over a month ago and nothing happened. Yesterday my card was billed $200 again for a shipment I do not want. I have called five times and left messages and nobody has called me back. Cancel this membership and refund the charge, or my next step is posting about this everywhere I can.
